prompt: Who was the most recent Sheriff of Los Angeles County killed in the line of duty?
answer:
The most recent Los Angeles County sheriff to be killed in the line of duty was **Sheriff James R. Barton**, the county’s second sheriff. He was **ambushed and killed in 1857**—along with members of his posse—while pursuing outlaws.

The three LASD detectives killed in the 2025 training-facility explosion were more recent department fatalities, but none was the sheriff himself.
